name: Muhammad III of Morocco
contribution: The Sultan of Morocco from 1757 to 1790 as a member of the 'Alawi dynasty.

checks.lead: Sidi Muhammad bin Abdallah al-Khatib (Arabic: سيدي محمد بن عبد الله الخطيب), commonly known as Muhammad III (Arabic: محمد الثالث), (c. 1710 – 9 April 1790) was the Sultan of Morocco from 1757 to 1790 as a member of the 'Alawi dynasty. He was the governor of Marrakesh around 1750. He was also briefly sultan in 1748. He rebuilt many cities after the earthquake of 1755, including Mogador, Casablanca, and Rabat. Historians such as Abdallah Laroui have described him as "the architect of modern Morocco."
